raw_response: {"diagnosis":"raw_transactions contains 144 txn_ids that are repeated as exact copies in every column, including batch_id and ingest_ts. This looks like duplicate delivery. silver_transactions does not dedupe, so the copies inflate silver and every gold table built from it. Deduplicating on txn_id is safe because the copies are identical.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, batch_id) = 1;"}}
